entry.title: 人生进阶指南｜一个普通人的失败、恢复与重新学习
entry.summary: 《人生进阶指南》中英双语开放书稿：以低谷与恢复为主线，从英语、AI 与真实项目出发，用可复测的行动把改变交给时间。

entry.title: Still Here: A Field Guide to Beginning Again
entry.summary: A bilingual open manuscript about failure, recovery, and relearning — with English, AI, real work, and evidence, from Life Level-up Guide.

entry.title: Bibliography
entry.summary: The studies, official guidance, and specifications actually cited in Still Here, grouped by subject and mapped to the chapter that uses each source.

entry.title: Reading Map: Enter by Problem
entry.summary: Seven doorways into Still Here, a table for choosing one English skill, one complete reading arc, and the four traces worth leaving from every chapter.

entry.title: Sources, Citation, and Verification
entry.summary: How Still Here separates research findings, personal experience, and untested hypotheses, how AI material is rechecked, and how to cite the book correctly.

entry.title: Copyright, Edition, and Citation
entry.summary: The edition, titles, byline, licence, non-medical boundary, source rules, and citation format for Still Here, and a plain statement that no publisher or ISBN is attached.

entry.title: Who This Book Is For — and Not For
entry.summary: An honest account of who Still Here is written for, who it may not suit, and two short letters to younger readers and to anyone in a difficult season.

entry.title: Prologue: Do Not Rush to Change Your Life
entry.summary: Begin with a real fall. After a company fails, a body breaks, and relationships strain, one ordinary person learns to catch himself first, then begin learning again through English, AI, real work, and time.

entry.title: How to Read This Book
entry.summary: A route for a first-time reader of Still Here — start with the story or the method, enter by the problem in front of you, return after an interruption, and leave one page of promises.

entry.title: Book Roadmap
entry.summary: A six-part map of Still Here, three reading paths through it, and a way to begin when you have five minutes or very little capacity today.

entry.title: Learning English with AI: From Practice to Real Delivery
entry.summary: Use English baselines, authentic material, guided practice, four-skill feedback, and delayed retesting instead of outsourcing English ability to one AI product.

entry.title: Part II: Learning Again, Opening Input
entry.summary: After catching yourself, begin again from English as one concrete training ground: build a real baseline, and let input pass through recall, expression, and feedback until it works in a new situation.

entry.title: Decision-Making: Choosing Under Uncertainty
entry.summary: Use facts, values, decision authority, costs, reversibility, and stop gates to think through career, money, relationships, health, and AI-era decisions.

entry.title: My Story: Failure, Recovery, and Starting Again
entry.summary: A personal account of business setbacks, entrepreneurial losses, disrupted health and life, and finding the courage to act again after returning home.

entry.title: Part I: Return to Life
entry.summary: Put failure, the body, relationships, work, and choice back inside one life, then find a way forward through facts, responsibility, care, and shared burdens.

entry.title: AI Trends and a Learning Roadmap: Turn Change into Ability
entry.summary: Use primary signals, reproducible experiments, and independent transfer to decide which AI capabilities are worth learning, covering agents, multimodal inputs, context, local models, evaluation, and provenance.

entry.title: 90-Day Action Plan: Return Your Life to Yourself
entry.summary: A repeatable 90-day system for turning goals, baselines, output, feedback, artifacts, and health boundaries into visible change.

entry.title: After Ninety Days: Let Change Remain in Life
entry.summary: Close an action cycle with evidence, transfer, stopping conditions, seasonal rhythm, and annual review so temporary progress becomes an ability life can keep using.

entry.title: Case Study: Let the Book Prove Its Method
entry.summary: Use Life Level-up Guide itself as an end-to-end case, showing how a long-running content project can move from an unclear wish into structure, artifacts, evidence, publication, reader feedback, and maintainable handover.

entry.title: Part V: Long-Term Action
entry.summary: Give one real problem ninety days, using phase gates, evidence, rhythm, and stopping conditions so long-term change can face life and time.

entry.title: Afterword: The Greatest Progress Is Finding Your True Self
entry.summary: A closing return from the first English question to failure, health, relationships, AI, and ordinary action, asking whether our greatest progress lies in finding our true selves.

entry.title: 序章：先不要急着改变人生
entry.summary: 从一次真实的坠落写起：公司倒闭、身体失控、关系受损之后，一个普通人怎样先把自己接住，再重新学习英语、使用 AI、做出作品，并让改变接受时间的检验。

entry.title: 如何读这本书
entry.summary: 给第一次打开《人生进阶指南》的读者一条可选择的路线：先读故事还是先学方法，如何按问题进入，怎样在中断之后回来，以及这一页可以留下的承诺。

entry.title: 本书路线图
entry.summary: 用一张六部结构表和三條阅读路径说明《人生进阶指南》的阅读顺序、每一步留下的东西，以及容量很小时怎样开始。

entry.title: 用 AI 学英语：从练习到真实交付
entry.summary: 用英语基线、真实材料、引导练习、四项能力反馈和延迟复测学习，而不是把英语能力外包给一个 AI 产品。

entry.title: 第二部：重新学习，打开输入
entry.summary: 把自己接住之后，从英语这个具体的训练场重新开始：建立真实基线，让输入经过回忆、表达与反馈，成为能在新场景中使用的能力。

entry.title: 选择篇：在不确定中做决定
entry.summary: 用事实、价值、决定权、代价、可逆性和停止门槛整理职业、金钱、关系、健康与 AI 时代的个人选择。

entry.title: 我的故事：失败、恢复与重新出发
entry.summary: 一段关于事业起落、创业失利、身体与生活失序，以及回家恢复后重新找回行动勇气的个人记录。

entry.title: 第一部：把自己放回生活
entry.summary: 把失败、身体、关系、事业与选择重新放进同一段人生，在事实、责任、珍惜与分担之间，找到一条能够继续的路。

entry.title: AI 趋势与学习路线：把变化变成能力
entry.summary: 用一手信号、可复现实验和独立迁移判断 AI 的新能力是否值得学习，覆盖智能体、多模态、上下文、本地模型、评测与来源追踪。

entry.title: 行动篇：九十天，把生活交还给自己
entry.summary: 用目标、基线、输出、反馈、作品和身体边界，建立一套可复测、可恢复的九十天行动系统。

entry.title: 九十天以后：把改变留在生活里
entry.summary: 在一个行动周期结束后，用关账、迁移、停止条件、季节节律与年度回看，把阶段成果变成能被生活继续使用的能力。

entry.title: 案例篇：让这本书证明它的方法
entry.summary: 以《人生进阶指南》自身为贯穿案例，展示一个长期内容项目如何从模糊愿望走向结构、作品、证据、出版、读者反馈与可交接维护。

entry.title: 第五部：行动与长期改变
entry.summary: 把一个真实问题交给九十天，用阶段门槛、证据链、节律与停止条件，让长期改变接受生活和时间的检验。

entry.title: 后记：人生最大的进阶，是找到真正的自己
entry.summary: 从最初的英语问题回到失败、身体、关系、AI 与日常行动，回答人生最大的进阶为何是找到真正的自己。
